d:
A Dark-type Pokémon resembling a canine-like creature with a massive, flowing plume of snowy white fur extending from the head and chest. The eyes are a piercing crimson red with a sharp, focused expression. The body is slender with a deep charcoal grey coat and a thick, white, fluffy tail that curves upward. Four toes with sharp claws are on each paw.
BODY COLOR: deep charcoal grey
